name: Lesson book (Sanskrit curriculum)
description: A progressive Sanskrit-through-Trika lesson: every passage reconstructed from its smallest linguistic components before philosophical interpretation. Ten stacked layers per lesson (witness → recitation → padaccheda → morphology → compounds → sandhi proof → syntax → translation → Trika exegesis → practice), three depths in one chapter (Learn it / Decode it / Recognise it). Witness and glosses come from translation-work layers; derivation and pedagogy are owner-reviewed and attributed; commentary never merges teachers.

constraints.trim: 6x9 152.4x228.6mm; interior no-bleed; full-wrap cover via styles/cover-canonical.json; study edition may use thesis.pages.fallback 400

paperback.spec: 6x9 cream B&W matte; study-edition ceiling 400pp (thesis.pages); interior no-bleed; full-wrap cover from styles/cover-canonical.json; kdp_preflight + check.py green before any upload

postcard.spec: Quote cards from a single lesson line (IAST + ref); never a substitute for the lesson

social.spec: 1080x1080 + 1080x1350 from one sandhi proof or one line; white ground, ink black, ref at foot

audiobook.spec: Recitation layer audio per lesson (Fish 'verse' voice on IAST) after owner go

chant.spec: Lesson recitation clips only where the source work already has aligned audio; no invented chant

digital.spec: Reflowable EPUB + DRM-free study PDF after build stage; exercises may ship as separate workbook later

series_pattern: Learn Sanskrit with Abhinavagupta: numbered volumes (v1 Everyday Recognition pocket prayers → later volumes by grammar stage); overflow = next volume, never a fatter book beyond thesis.pages.
inclusion: every lesson carries the ten layers in order, each building on the previous — not independent encyclopedia entries
witness (Devanagari, IAST, author, work, verse, edition) is extract-and-place from translation-work; no invented Sanskrit
morphology, sandhi proofs and syntax are reversible: input → rule → output, with alternatives recorded when commentators differ
translation is demonstrably derived from the grammar before any metaphysics is introduced
Trika exegesis attributes verse, Abhinavagupta, Kṣemarāja, Yogarāja, Lakshmanjoo and our synthesis separately
reading mode keeps irreverent everyday clarity; learning mode never skips morphology or fakes pronunciation
grammar knowledge accumulates: a form mastered in an earlier lesson is reinforced, not re-taught from zero
exclusion: never invent Sanskrit, etymologies, or Pāṇini rule ids that have not been verified
never silently resolve a parse ambiguity or merge distinct teachers into one voice
never present a modern practice adaptation as an ancient prescription
never print Lakshmanjoo/Dyczkowski prose at length — brief attributed quotation only (house copyright law)
never claim the textbook is the verse's home when a reference volume owns the full text — quotation with attribution only
no PDF build before content, structure and formatting pass — build is last

cover.house_constant: back cover = black ground + Svatantrya mantra-ring logo, small, centred; no back text, no second element
cover.swap_rule: replace meta.cover_image only; geometry and back logo stay house-constant
